reviews.t: Looks like I went to the Nail Salon
reviews.x: Love this.. it took a little while to do, but it was my first time.. I realize I don’t need to use much and maybe made them a little to thick. I really like them and one nail actually came off and real nail looks perfectly fine... no damage like what acrylic does to my nails.. I don’t have to go to a salon and sit there with a darn mask on for an hour! Love it!! And saves soooo much money.. I love the little caboodle it came with..oh yeah and good luck finding rubbing alcohol. I’m running low!

Being honest - when I first started working with gel I wasn't sure if I liked it or not, so a kit like this would have been super helpful.  The gels themselves have nice self leveling. claims.text: Many reviewers find this to be a great, affordable starter kit for beginners, with everything included.
Several reviewers report the gel/polish is too thick or sticky and comes off easily, especially with water contact.
Some reviewers say the UV lamp does not work well or fails to cure the product properly.
A few reviewers complain about cheap materials, messiness, and poor quality overall.
Some reviewers note the instructions are subpar and recommend watching videos or following directions carefully.
